review_scope: Static pre-analysis review of the published fixed protocol only; no new disclosure values, new classifications or EX037 outcome calculations inspected.
approved_method_properties: All 27 report-level records remain visible; the latest period in each existing formal disclosure cluster determines the primary event classification, yielding the fixed 25-event universe without return-based selection.

Compare identical-period YTD parent-attributable profit; do not invent quarterly forecasts by differencing guidance bounds or extend headline coverage to revenue, margin, cash flow or all report information.
Earlier guidance requires both a strictly earlier official source day and a strictly earlier conservative tradable decision cluster. Same-cluster guidance remains separate.
The latest admitted earlier version controls classification. Preserve revisions and their replacement evidence; unresolved same-day ordering remains unavailable.

Decimal rounding boundaries are fixed before new-value/outcome analysis. Positive and negative breakouts require the entire actual cents interval to exceed the conservative prior bound; boundary overlap remains separate.
Covered means no certified numeric boundary breakout and does not mean no new information, no reduction in uncertainty or no market surprise.

Two predeclared directional contrasts reuse the fixed EX036 labels and 21 dependence blocks. Empty groups remain unavailable; each arm requires at least two contributing blocks for a descriptive interval.

First-news reactions and source-type strata are descriptive only. Existing market coverage limits availability; no alternate horizon, fitted model, continuous account or new candidate is authorized by this protocol.

implementation_and_reporting_notes.condition: For a point express value represented as L=U with a positive printed quantum, the definite-covered interval [L+qL/2,U-qU/2] is empty.
implementation_and_reporting_notes.required_interpretation: Under the published rule, even an identical formal and express printed value is rounding_boundary_overlap rather than covered. Retain and report this structural exclusion of point-valued reports; do not silently relax it after observing classifications or returns.
implementation_and_reporting_notes.revision_boundary: If point-consistent express values are intended to enter the covered arm, publish an explicit pre-analysis protocol revision before inspecting new value/outcome results. This review does not authorize changing the published classifier.

implementation_and_reporting_notes.required_interpretation: If the latest relevant source is an approximate single-point estimate or has unresolved basis/order, retain its declared non-primary classification. Do not select an older convenient interval merely to obtain a primary classification.

Determine each quantum from the stated monetary unit and printed decimal places, including printed decimal zeros; retain signed losses and normalize interval order. Do not infer a monetary baseline from uncertified percentage guidance or optimize a surprise tolerance.

A boundary breakout is an increment relative to the scoped issuer headline chain, not proof of an unexpected event to the market. Earlier-guidance price paths and later event returns do not establish causal price absorption or executable continuous-strategy performance.

next_review: After source collection, independently verify issuer/period/scope, signed units and printed quantum, first/latest/replacement chronology, complete scoped-query receipts, all 27 report classifications and 25 event joins, then recompute the two fixed effects without expanding research scope.
